sentences.en: The monophasic action potentials (MAP) of epicardium (Epi), midmyocardium (Mid) and endocardium (Endo) were recorded simultaneously in left ventricular free wall in vivo by a compound electrode.

sentences.en: Objective To investigate the relationship between epicardium adipose thickness and the severity of coronary artery stenosis in patients with coronary artery disease.

sentences.en: It demonstrated the procedure of radiofrequency ablating the epicardium could be a practicable treatment for AF.
